original_text: \cite{Gonzalez2025} confirm the AGN component from \textit{Hyde} and surrounding sources
injected_text: \cite{Gonzalez2025} rule out an AGN component from \textit{Hyde} and surrounding sources
rationale: Direction reversal of cited conclusion. Gonzalez et al. 2025 (Gonzalez2025) report G235H high-resolution IFU observations that CONFIRM AGN-driven broad-line emission from Hyde and the surrounding overdensity members. Reversing the polarity from 'confirm the AGN component' to 'rule out an AGN component' contradicts the cited paper's central result; cite key is preserved byte-for-byte.
ground_truth_description: Polarity flip of the citation claim: 'confirm the AGN component' → 'rule out an AGN component'. Gonzalez2025 explicitly confirms AGN-driven broad-line emission from Hyde via JWST/NIRSpec G235H IFU; the injected sentence asserts the opposite.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: \cite{Gonzalez2025} confirm the AGN component from \textit{Hyde} and surrounding sources, implying that major mergers can trigger AGN activity within this overdense environment

rationale: Normalisation prefactor drop on the canonical overdensity definition. Standard δ = (n−n̄)/n̄. Adding a factor of 2 in the denominator gives δ = (n−n̄)/(2n̄), which underestimates the overdensity by 50%. Wolfram refutes against the canonical identity δ + 1 = n/n̄ (any direct substitution of n=2n̄ would give δ=1 in canonical, δ=0.5 in injected).
ground_truth_description: Inserted a factor of 2 in the denominator of the overdensity definition: δ = (n−n̄)/n̄ → δ = (n−n̄)/(2n̄). The canonical normalisation is broken; δ now reaches 0.5 (instead of 1) at n = 2n̄.

rationale: Abstract↔body internal contradiction. The body keeps the original claim ('with 3.8 times more galaxies than the average') and δ~2.8, so the abstract and body now contradict.
